anomalies.observed: On the EthernetAndPower sheet, the LAN1 signal wires from U5 are shown as separate from the corresponding data terminals of J5; the RJ45 data pins have no connection to those nets.
anomalies.expected: The RJ45 data terminals should connect to the SKW92A LAN1 transmit and receive pairs so the Ethernet jack can carry network traffic.

evidence.quote: LAN1_TX+, LAN1_TX-, LAN1_RX+, LAN1_RX- are shown beside J5 RJ45_Amphenol_RJMG1BD3B8K1ANR, but the signal wires do not reach its data terminals. (EthernetAndPower.kicad_sch, page 4)
J5 Ethernet jack; the RJ45 jack's data pads ... all appear ... individually unconnected. (Design specification, §2–3)

anomalies.impact: The RJ45 jack will not provide a wired Ethernet connection to the SKW92A, despite the LAN1 PHY signals being present.

parsed.summary: The schematic appears to leave J5's Ethernet data terminals open from the SKW92A's LAN1 signal nets. This would make the RJ45 interface nonfunctional.
